Commerce Ministry Amends Export Mission Rules to Aid Exporters

The Commerce Ministry has amended certain rules under its Export Promotion Mission initiative to provide support to exporters. Revised guidelines now permit Micro and Small Exporters to claim up to 95% of their airfare costs for participation in international trade fairs, buyer-seller meets, and trade delegations.
